captures.description: THE WORKSHOP, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Wordcraft Writers Workshop was a 2022 research project by Google’s PAIR (People + AI Research) and Magenta teams that explored AI-augmented creative writing.' Overview and setup (the tool, its features, the cohort 'under non-disclosure agreements', the results); '2026 Literary Backlash' (the project 'resurfaced widely on social media (such as Bluesky)' in August 2026; the criticism that participants 'had lent credibility to AI models trained on copyrighted literary works without consent'; participants' responses). Eight cards: Google (two), Magenta, ActuIA, The Algorithmic Bridge, Engadget, Coralflavor, Mezha.

atoms.evidence: The Wordcraft Writers Workshop was a 2022 research project
by Google’s PAIR (People + AI Research) and Magenta teams
Participants used Wordcraft, an experimental text editor powered by Google’s LaMDA language model.
Thirteen diverse professional authors (including Ken Liu, Robin Sloan, and Eugenia Triantafyllou) spent eight weeks writing short stories with the tool
